description: Integration test fails instead of skipping without a database.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+package propose
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"os"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
+)
+
+func TestRunStatsColumn(t *testing.T) {
+	pool, err := pgxpool.New(context.Background(), os.Getenv("TEST_DATABASE_URL"))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer pool.Close()
+	if _, err := pool.Exec(context.Background(), `select stats from public.runs limit 1`); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+}
